reuse.why: Extends the shared getScheduledAmount with the operator and reuses the existing getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the tolerance instead of recomputing 7.5%.

duplication.why: The approximate rule is defined once in the helper; call sites only pass their op.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts and the tolerance comes from shared/rules, the existing home of approximate matching.

scope.why: Focused on the rule and threading op through every planning caller; the positional insertion of op before inverse forces touching existing inverse tests but nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: A single tested definition, though adding op as a stringly-typed positional parameter ahead of inverse makes calls like (x, 'is', true) a bit brittle.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts; every planning caller (api-models, schedule-template, forecast, schedules/app x2, preview, Balance, SchedulesTable, mobile list) now passes its op to it.
